aboutus.banner.desc: Guqula indawo yakho yokuhlala ngokhaphethi bethu abawubukhazikhazi, lapho isitayela nokunethezeka kuhlangana kuyo yonke imicu.
aboutus.desc: Uyemukelwa ku-Al-Barkaat Overseas, lapho isiko lihlangana khona nokuqamba okusha emhlabeni wezingubo zaphansi ezinhle. Uthando lwethu lwamaragi lugxile kakhulu kuyo yonke imicu, futhi siyaziqhenya ngokwethula kuwe izinhlobonhlobo ezikhethwe ngokucophelela zamaragi aveza ukunethezeka, ukunethezeka, nokunotha kwamasiko. Noma ngabe ufuna ukufaka isikhala sakho ngemfudumalo yesiko, ukuyenga kwedizayini yesimanje, noma inhlanganisela evumelanayo yakho kokubili, omata bethu benzelwe ukudlula ukuhlobisa nje futhi babe amafa ayigugu ekhaya noma ehhovisi lakho. Ngena endaweni lapho ubuciko buhlangana khona namagugu, lapho imiklamo engaphelelwa isikhathi ihlangana khona nokuzwela kwesimanje - thola umata ophelele ukuze uhambisane nesitayela sakho ngasinye futhi uphakamise indawo ohlala kuyo e-Al-Barkaat Overseas.
aboutus.service1: Ukwembula Inani Elingajwayelekile: Inhloso yethu igxile ekucebiseni ulwazi lwakho ngamanani ancintisanayo, ukukhuthaza ubambiswano, nokuletha isevisi engenakuqhathaniswa.
aboutus.service2: Ukuphakamisa Ubuhle: Uhambo lwethu lugxile ekuphishekeleni okungapheli kokuphelela. Ngokuzinikela okujulile ekusunguleni izinto ezintsha kanye nokuzinikela okungantengantengi ekuqinisekiseni ukwaneliseka kwakho okukhulu, sizama ukuchaza kabusha amabhentshimakhi embonini. Hlanganyela nathi njengoba siqala uhambo olubheke ekusaseni eliqhakazile, elinempumelelo.
aboutus.service3: Ukwamukela Amathuba Angapheli: Umbono wethu udlulela ngale komkhathizwe njengoba samukela usuku ngalunye oluchichima ngamathuba amasha okukhula nokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Sizinikele ekusaseni eligqugquzelwa ukuqamba okusha, inqubekelaphambili, namandla angenamkhawulo, sikumema ukuthi uhlanganyele nathi ekulolongeni ukulandisa kwakusasa.
aboutus.service4: Inani Lokwenza Ubuciko, Ukuqinisekisa Ukusebenza Okuhle: Siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngokuzibophezela kwethu ekukunikezeni ezinye zezintengo ezincintisana kakhulu embonini. Ukuphishekela kwethu ngokungaphezi ukusebenza kahle kwezindleko kanye nokutholakala kwamasu kusivumela ukuthi selule ukonga okukhulu kuwe. Sikholelwa ngokuqinile ukuthi ukufinyeleleka akufanele neze kubeke engcupheni ikhwalithi yesevisi noma imikhiqizo oyitholayo. Ngakho-ke, sigcina ukugxila okungantengantengi ekuletheni inani elingenakuqhathaniswa kanye nokwenza kahle.
